ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels on the visible lobe segment.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels are concentrated at the distal tip and along the trailing edge margin. The proximal and central regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity black blob with isolated white pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary on the visible lobe featuring irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude variance of approximately 4-8 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of the visible lobe, terminating in a sharp, upward-tilted distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several discrete, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed across the lower-central black region of the visible lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white pixel fringe localized exclusively to the distal third of the trailing edge on the visible lobe.
